ground_truth: Automatically derive semantic-material-policy references from independent RELLIS image IDs on suitable SAM masks. This is a policy proxy, not physical traversability truth. See docs/automatic_references.md.

static_target.sampling: Uniform keyframes within each annotated recording; select planning-relevant regions before model inference.

sources.name: RELLIS-3D
sources.access_checked: Official repository and linked download pages identified; bulk transfer not tested; Google Drive quotas may apply.
sources.split_limit: Held-out recordings on one campus; do not claim independent geographic sites.

sources.name: TUM RGB-D fr1 floor
sources.purpose: Shared pipeline video: ground and camera motion
sources.use: Extract timestamped RGB for VLM input; archive also contains other modalities, which are excluded from VLM input.
sources.labels_needed: Selected semantic policy labels and hazard visibility times; no native traversability or SAM track labels.

sources.name: TUM RGB-D fr3 walking xyz
sources.purpose: Shared pipeline video: people and occlusion
sources.use: Extract timestamped RGB. This office sequence stresses dynamic visibility; it is not a rich ground-hazard dataset.
sources.labels_needed: Selected semantic policy labels and hazard visibility times; no native traversability or SAM track labels.

sources.name: Own phone clips
sources.purpose: Optional shared pipeline temporal test and small-hazard extension; not required by the public classification benchmark
cases: Ground during camera translation and turns
Cups and cables at different distances
Person occluding and revealing a hazard
Object placed onto previously clear ground
SAM target splitting or merging across views
sources.recording: Ground-facing view at the intended camera height; retain original frames and timestamps.
sources.shared_video_annotation: Record visibility/change event times and inspect a few key frames; dense frame/voxel labeling is not required. No separate VLM smoothing benchmark.

alternative_if_rellis_unavailable.name: GOOSE 2D validation
alternative_if_rellis_unavailable.access_checked: Official links resolved to ZIP responses; archive not downloaded.
alternative_if_rellis_unavailable.use: Replace outdoor source only; rebuild split by recording/location, freeze it before testing, and manually annotate robot-policy labels.
